subject: Indemnity cap exception request & evidence onboarding
content:
From: Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@novablue.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@novablue.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. Contracts attached our redlines to the Order Form and MSA. Two items are blockers for legal before we can proceed: (1) we cannot accept Redwood's standard $1M aggregate cap for third-party IP claims tied to model output; NovaBlue requires an uncapped or materially higher cap for IP infringement that results from model output (we're asking for uncapped for IP but understand that may be hard); (2) we need a clear evidence/onboarding process for notices (who collects technical evidence, expected SLA to request outputs, and a single liaison).

I attached NovaBlue_Redlines_20270501.pdf with inline comments. If Redwood can offer either an exception (uncapped for IP claims) or a higher cap plus insurance/escrow, we can move forward. Also propose a 21-day notice window for evidence collection and a named contacts list.

Can you share next steps/timeline? We are targeting procurement sign-off by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Ellie
Contracts Manager
NovaBlue Health

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@novablue.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Hi Ellie — thanks for the redlines and for being direct about the blockers. I'm looping in Legal (Kimberly) and our AE (Ben) to work through options.

Internally, our asks will be:
- Is there a commercial concession we can offer to bridge to a higher cap?
- What evidence/onboarding workflow can we operationalize (and who owns it)?

Kimberly — can you review NovaBlue's proposed redlines (attached) and propose a compromise we can take to the customer by EOD tomorrow? Ben/grace — please flag any operational constraints on evidence collection (21-day window).

Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Team — I reviewed NovaBlue_Redlines_20270501.pdf. Below is a recommended position we should present as a firm/legal compromise (not internal final until exec signs off):

Proposal (legal compromise):
- Keep a monetary cap but raise it to $5,000,000 (aggregate) specifically for third-party IP claims that allege infringement tied to model output. All other liabilities remain subject to the existing $1M cap.
- Carve out direct indemnity for third-party patent claims limited to documented direct damages; exclude consequential/indirect damages.
- Require NovaBlue to provide a technical evidence bundle within 21 days of notice (sample checklist attached in RI_proposed_redline_20270502.docx). That bundle must include original prompt, timestamps, output artifacts, and any downstream processing.
- Add obligation for NovaBlue to cooperate in defense and to permit Redwood to control defense (defense control option retained), subject to standard reservation of rights.
- If NovaBlue requires uncapped IP indemnity, we will require proof of primary insurance (cyber/tech E&O) naming Redwood as additional insured and an escrow deposit equal to 12 months of committed usage.

Rationale: $5M is material and shows we're sensitive to enterprise concerns while keeping program risk bounded. The evidence bundle and cooperation obligations are critical to operationalize any defense and to avoid spurious claims. Insurance/escrow is the lever to address uncapped exposure if they insist.

Attachments: RI_proposed_redline_20270502.docx (redline markup and evidence checklist).

Questions for Ops (Grace): can you confirm the 21-day evidence window is realistic operationally and whether we can accept S3 signed URLs or we need full artifact upload into our secure intake?

Kimberly
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Thanks Kim — operational notes:
- 21 days for providing a technical bundle is workable, provided the customer stores output artifacts at the time of generation and provides signed URLs or a secure archive. We cannot retroactively reconstruct outputs without their cooperation.
- We can accept S3 pre-signed URLs (read-only, 7-day expiry) or a secure zip uploaded to our secure intake. We will log a ticket to Ops for preservation and chain-of-custody tracking.
- Onboarding: we recommend a short runbook and a single named liaison from NovaBlue for evidence requests to avoid delays. I'll draft a 1-page intake SLA for signatures.

Grace
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Team — commercial suggestion to close: offer the $5M cap + a commitment to provide a 6-month credit equal to one month of committed usage if NovaBlue signs within 7 days. If they push for uncapped, require proof of insurance (minimum $10M tech E&O) and escrow as Kim recommended.

If legal okays, I'll propose the $5M + credit and include our 1-page evidence SLA. That should be acceptable commercial trade-off and avoids opening wide exposure.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@novablue.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@novablue.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines — indemnity cap exception request

Thanks all — this is helpful. NovaBlue can accept a $5M aggregate cap specifically for IP claims tied to model output, provided Redwood: (a) accepts NovaBlue's named liaison approach; (b) commits to the 21-day evidence window and accepts S3 pre-signed URLs; and (c) provides proof of insurance or agrees to provide a 12-month escrow if we move to uncapped later. We'd also like the 6-month credit Ben offered as part of commercial consideration.

If you can circulate a DocuSign with these points captured (and the redline attached), I'll get this through procurement this afternoon.

Ellie
Contracts Manager
NovaBlue Health

Next steps (internal summary):
- Legal to finalize redline doc (RI_proposed_redline_20270502.docx) with $5M cap, evidence checklist, and insurance/escrow language.
- Ops (Grace) to draft 1-page evidence SLA and confirm S3 pre-signed URL intake flow.
- Ben to include 6-month credit in the commercial offer.
- Jasmine to send DocuSign envelope to Ellie with updated Order Form + 1-page SLA + proof-of-insurance template (insurance_proof_template.pdf).
